content_fields.title: Ensure pipeline efficiency and security (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Configure the build pipeline for secure and efficient execution.
content_fields.guidance: Pipelines should pin third-party actions by commit SHA, scope tokens to the minimum permissions, avoid running untrusted pull-request code with secrets in scope, and cache only non-sensitive content with keys that cannot be poisoned.
content_fields.found: No pipeline definition exists in the repository.
content_fields.missing: The workflow files themselves plus the platform-level runner and secret settings.
content_fields.conclusion: There is no pipeline definition here to harden; creating one and configuring the platform is a CI/CD ownership decision.
content_fields.action: The CI/CD owners should create the pipeline and apply the hardening baseline when build automation is introduced.
